title: Nomad Driving School
summary: Panam bets V cannot run the clan kids' route through the Badlands under her time, then rides shotgun and grades the run.
description: Panam bets V cannot run the clan kids' route through the Badlands under her time. She plans to ride shotgun and grade the run, and she has her own line to show V.

start.bringUp: You've seen V drive and you have opinions. Bring up, in your own way, the clan kids' route through the Badlands and bet V cannot run it under your time.

meet.name: the camp at Rocky Ridge where the trucks are parked

riverbed.name: the dry riverbed below Rocky Ridge

turbines.name: the wind turbines near Biotechnica Flats

ramp.name: the dirt ramp off the canyon road

sunset.name: the Sunset Motel forecourt in Rocky Ridge

P3.dare.01.text: I've seen you drive. It's like watching a man fight a vending machine.

P3.dare.02.text: Clan kids run a route out here. Bet you can't beat my time.

P3.run.01.text: Riverbed first. Brake before the dip, not in it.

P3.run.03.text: Turbines. Stay left, the right side's soft sand.

P3.run.04.text: Ramp. Commit or don't, nothing in between.

P3.run.05.text: Bridge. Mitch lost a bumper here in sixty-eight.

P3.her.01.text: My turn. Watch the line, not the speedometer.

P3.grade.01.text: Under my time. I hate you. I'm also a little proud.

P3.grade.02.text: For a city driver? Respectable. For a nomad, a disgrace.

P3.grade.03.text: Five stars for the crash. Zero for everything else.

g1.asks: What's it going to be, a bet or are you scared?
g1.know: The clan kids' route through the Badlands, the five checkpoints, her time, and an eddies stake may be put on the bet.
g1.secret: Her time was set years ago and she is not sure she can still beat it herself.

stages.label: Panam bets V cannot beat the kids' route
stages.objective: Hear Panam's bet at the Rocky Ridge camp
stages.know: You are at the camp by the trucks. Panam thinks V drives like a city driver and wants to see the kids' route run under her time.
stages.wants: V to take the bet or refuse it.

stages.label: V drives the kids' route with Panam in the passenger seat
stages.objective: Drive the kids' route with Panam, ending at the Sunset Motel
stages.know: V is at the wheel of the car and Panam is in the passenger seat. The route runs through the riverbed, the turbines, the ramp and the old rail bridge, back to the Sunset Motel. The time limit is six game minutes.
stages.wants: V to run the route under Panam's time.

stages.label: Panam shows V her line
stages.objective: Watch Panam take her own line at the Sunset Motel
stages.know: V finished the kids' route. Panam wants to show V how it is done.
stages.wants: V to watch and learn the line.

ace.memory: You beat the kids' route through the Badlands under Panam's time, and she made you swear not to tell Mitch.

crash-out.memory: You gave up on the kids' route, or wrecked the car, and Panam is still laughing about it.

chicken.memory: You would not take Panam's bet on the kids' route, and she called you chicken.
